mainText: Hello, Verona! At 7 AM, here is today's balanced dish: we have clear skies and a temperature of 45 degrees, which feels like 41, down at Fireman's Park.

In city news, police were dispatched to the 600 block of Hunter's Cove Way on September 10th for a burglary in progress, where they took an individual into custody and recovered a handgun without any reported injuries.

There is a busy schedule ahead, starting with Yoga at Insight Wellness today. Tomorrow, you can look forward to trivia at Hop Haus and the Wisconsin Brewing Company, while Tuesday features the Downtown Farmer's Market and more trivia at Paddy Mac's.
On September 10th, Verona officers responded to a residential burglary on Hunter's Cove Way, resulting in the arrest of a 19-year-old on burglary and recklessly endangering safety charges.
Culver's is currently closed for a remodel but will be ready to serve you when they open today at 10:00 AM.
